The sun rises. Your home starts making power.

A picture of the vision. Actual power depends on your home, system and weather.

The pilot: a home that takes care of itself.

Solar on the roof makes your power. A battery keeps it for the night. And a brain in the house runs it all for you, so the lights stay on and you stop thinking about it.

The first pilot homes are going up now, right here in Arizona, built by licensed partners, coordinated by KYE.

The first pilot homes go to the list first.

Solar makes your power

Panels on your roof turn Arizona sun into electricity for your home. Power you make yourself, right where you live.

Power that goes anywhere

The battery stores extra power for the night, for cloudy days, and for when the grid goes down. Stored sunshine, ready wherever you need it. Your home keeps running either way.

The brain runs it all

Kai, the intelligence inside the home, learns how your family lives and moves power where it's needed, quietly, in the background, day and night.

Fair questions

What exactly am I signing up for?

A place in line for KYE's pilot program, the first homes getting solar, a battery, and Kai, the brain that runs it all. Joining the list isn't buying anything. It means when a pilot spot opens, you're one of the first people we call.

Does it cost anything to join?

No. The list is free, and there's no commitment. When your turn comes up, we walk you through everything, what it costs and how it runs, before you decide anything.

Why a waitlist? Why not just start?

Because every home gets done right, a few at a time, by licensed partners, with real panels and batteries kept ready for the homes on the list. The list is how we know who to build for first.

I'm not in Arizona. Can I still join?

Yes. The first pilot homes are in Arizona, but the movement is for the world. Join the list and tell us your city. It helps us decide where KYE goes next.
